Built a complete playable 2D/3D-style tomb climbing game.

- Keyboard and mobile touch controls
- Procedural vertical platforms
- Collectible relics
- Pause and sound controls
- Animated atmospheric temple
- Depth tracking and win state
- Portrait rotation notice

Assumption: implemented as a canvas-based 2D game with 3D visual depth rather than a full 3D engine.
